reviewed_rerank_history.reason: Shroud established a shared target-advertisement and resolution-revalidation boundary with privacy-sensitive multiplayer behavior; that universal legality dependency was more urgent than the already dependency-ready counter-producer harvest.

Echo exercised upkeep ownership, source control and departure, trigger placement, payment, compact-CI data closure, and exact replay across several universal systems; the cross-owner correctness value outweighed its smaller card gain.

Crew became an architecture sentinel for advertised and submitted activation parity, effective power, summoning sickness, atomic tap commitment, layer-4 type results, projection, rollback, and replay; that foundation justified reranking it ahead of the counter queue.

The selected counter-producer closure had no measured card, ability, or residual gain, while a pinned-corpus probe found a coherent cross-effect sequence family above the 100-ability harvest threshold and outside the narrow fixed-counter queue; the landed census gained 92 exact Commander cards and removed 116 material residuals through existing typed effect owners.

The selected counter-producer closure still had no measured card, ability, or residual gain, while a pinned-corpus rerank measured a coherent fixed-query layer-6 family at 53 exact Commander cards and 69 exact abilities through existing Haste, Vigilance, Flying, strike-step, and Trample owners. The bounded grammar excludes multicolored and dynamic predicates rather than widening ObjectQuerySpec or characteristic-cycle scope.

The selected counter-producer closure still had no measured card, ability, or residual gain, while a pinned-corpus rerank measured one closed Devoid characteristic-definition family at 132 exact Commander abilities and six complete cards. Its copied typed fragment uses the existing layer-5 evaluator and all-zone characteristic boundary while leaving dynamic counts, text changes, and untrusted face-down producers outside trust.

The selected counter-producer closure remained an unknown-gain queue item after Reinforce, while the generated frontier measured the coherent destroy-target effect family at 21 exact Commander cards, 130 exact abilities, and 130 removable material residuals. The rank-one choose-one aggregate still has zero sole blockers and is not one coherent grammar family. selected_batch.rationale: The bounded mandatory fixed additional-token, ordinary Fabricate, single-permanent Explore, ordinary Proliferate, intrinsic entry including represented prospective Planeswalker and Battle tokens, fixed player, fixed positive ordinary-mana and fixed positive life cumulative-upkeep, normalized controller life-gain and draw-trigger, and closed public permanent-entry and creature-death counter-trigger families are capability-closed through shared replacement-aware transactions. Cumulative upkeep commits its age-counter replacement result before calculating payment, token creation exhausts additional-token choices before its simultaneous intrinsic-counter batch, player-result triggers consume public committed events, and zone-change triggers consume immutable current or last-known public facts before their counter bodies enter the canonical transaction. The remaining dependency-ready CR 614.16 boundary is counter-producer migration: loyalty costs, remaining rule-generated producers, and unsupported optional, variable, movement, prevention, subtype-qualified, aggregated, or linked families must enter typed resumable owners rather than bypassing replacement ordering. This remains a producer-ownership harvest, not a claim that aggregate replacement effects, Cumulative Upkeep, Fabricate variants, simultaneous Explore, or every event-trigger family is complete.
exit_criteria: Inventory every represented permanent- and player-counter producer and identify which paths still bypass the canonical counter-placement owner.
Route one coherent reusable producer family through the immutable resumable counter-placement transaction without adding direct GameState writes.
Preserve cost timing, entry timing, simultaneous APNAP ordering, rollback, privacy, and exact replay for migrated producers.
Add generic CardProgram lowering and precise source spans where the migrated family originates in Oracle text.
Add focused positive, negative, interaction, multiplayer, rollback, replay, and killed implementation-mutation evidence for the migrated boundary.
Leave unrepresented movement, removal, variable, optional, and linked-choice counter variants as explicit residuals and report actual Commander-card gains.
